policy: Evidence is model-specific and scope-limited. A deterministic software snapshot is never independent source reproduction. Source-equation checks do not prove external clinical predictive performance.

entries.sourceLocation: Roberts et al. (2011), final population model equations (3)-(4), Table 2
entries.population: 206 critically ill adults receiving vancomycin by continuous infusion
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent closed-form 1-compartment zero-order input: CL=4.58*(CRCL/100), V=1.53*WT, C(t)=rate/CL*(1-exp(-CL*t/V)), 0<t<=infusion duration.
verifiedScope: population concentrations for a single continuous infusion

entries.sourceLocation: Revilla et al. (2010), final covariate model; Table 4
entries.population: Adult ICU patients treated with intravenous vancomycin
entries.mathematicalOracle: Independent closed-form 1-compartment IV bolus: CL=(0.67*(CRCL/WT)+AGE^(-0.24))*WT*0.06, V=0.82*2.49^(CREAT_umolL/88.4>1)*WT, C(t)=dose/V*exp(-CL*t/V).
scenarios: higher renal clearance and older age
verifiedScope: conversion of kg-normalized mL/min clearance to L/h
population concentrations following an IV bolus
